content: We need to indicate number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly the sample is the one at hand, which we can get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. But we need the number of carbonyl groups. We need to get IR spectra (look for ~1700 cm-1). Could also get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). Since we don't know the molecule, we need to measure. Use IR first as cheap? Both are similar cost. Use IR to detect carbonyl groups. Let's call ir_spectra.
